items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: And that's with Big Nick--Nicholas. That was his gig.

ctx.x: And that's with Big Nick--Nicholas. That was his gig. That's where everybody would come in here. And so I was in a session in there when Kenny Dorham heard me up there playing. And he say "hey, man." He said "I like the--" he said "I like the way, the sound that you get out of the bass, see." Say "I'm fixing to get a band out." Say "you got eyes." I say "shit, yeah, man, you know." So what I--I wasn't really suffering too much because I--like I say I'm living with my father, you know my parents and stuff up…
